description: Companion: matchday feed. WHEN: you are RENTING a bot and want to follow it live — the Renter's Matchday feed. Narrates every match your rented bot has finished under your hire (newest first, played under your nickname), shows the match it is in right now, the escrow countdown (time left + credits still held), and flags 'your bot is idle' after 5 quiet minutes mid-hire so you know to rent_dispatch it more work. Pass hire_id or get your current rental (latest active, else most recent). Renter only — the feed is private to your hire. Read-only, 0 credits. Differs from rent_status (bookkeeping) and companion_day (the whole day, all relationships). Example: companion_matchday {}

hire_id.description: Optional rental id from rent_hire / rent_status. Default: your latest active rental (or most recent if none is active).

key.description: Your ark_ key (or send Authorization: Bearer <key>). Registered keys only.

name: companion_matchday
